chart.title: Distribution of Democracy Index
chart.subtitle: Data by Polity 5. Expert estimates of the extent to which open, multi-party, and competitive elections choose a chief executive who faces comprehensive institutional constraints, and political participation is competitive. The index here ranges from 0 to 20 (fully democratic).

Democracy (recoded 0-20).descriptionShort: It combines information on the extent to which open, multi-party, and competitive elections choose a chief executive who faces comprehensive institutional constraints, and political participation is competitive. It ranges from 0 to 20 (fully democratic).
Democracy (recoded 0-20).descriptionKey: We have other democracy data sources that also cover more recent years and have more precise data. You can find them in our [Key Democracy Charts](https://ourworldindata.org/democracy#all-charts) and [Democracy Data Explorer](https://ourworldindata.org/explorers/democracy).
Democracy (recoded 0-20).descriptionProcessing:
It matches the variable `polity2` in Polity 5 (2021), with the values rescaled to range from 0 to 20 instead of -10 to 10.
Values for continents have been obtained by averaging the values of the countries in the continent.
Democracy (recoded 0-20).citationShort: Polity 5 (2020) – processed by Our World in Data
Democracy (recoded 0-20).citationLong: Polity 5 (2020) – processed by Our World in Data. “Democracy Index” [dataset]. Polity 5, “Polity5 Project, Political Regime Characteristics and Transitions, 1800–2018 5” [original data].
